method: AGENTS and gameplay-reviewer read; static actual consumer audit. No Godot/GPU/movie executed. Implementation source is mutable and not accepted.

findings.static_observation: Player projectile context hit_direction is not copied into DamageRequest and contact requests lack a direction.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Commit one real left and one real right hit. Assert response is opposite incoming direction and no second move_and_slide occurs.

findings.static_observation: Formal Underworld hides PlayerFeedback without disabling its accepted Health audio subscriptions.
findings.minimal_counterexample: One accepted hit must generate exactly one hurt audio cue, no cue for denied duplicate/i-frame/stale epoch.

findings.static_observation: Environment Health change and SegmentRespawn occur in one batch before next render. A health-only local effect may render at the restored anchor or be cleared immediately.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Record actual hazard contact, exit at hazard, epoch invalidation, spawn entry/recovery, pause/reload transitions; no delayed duplicate HP or grants.

findings.static_observation: Body rejects every hit; bell damage additionally requires core_open and direction acceptance.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Real player swept projectile must deal damage during all active attack/telegraph/recovery modes; intro/dead/outside arena and stale shots must reject.

findings.static_observation: Bellstrider contact emitter uses fixed half_size 25x27 rather than the authoritative encounter body bounds. Windkeeper clamps to 72x62.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Traverse left/right/top/bottom actual body and just-outside; moving body sweep, phase transition, death, pause, reload; compare accepted contact to true shape.

findings.static_observation: Backside shortcut opens through W/interact proximity, outside ShotLatch path.
findings.minimal_counterexample: W/contact cannot open. A real current player projectile from valid side can; wrong side/enemy/stale/occluded hit cannot. Persistent opened ledger and real collision must survive reload.

findings.static_observation: Claimed chests retain closed PNG and only lower alpha to .35; reload installs same closed art.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Actual successful claim gives opaque open lid state; cancel/denied claim stays closed. Reload retains open pose without repeating reward.

findings.static_observation: Active NPC distance uses FLOOR_Y-18 for all entries and reserved proximity uses abs(x) only.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Different floors sharing x cannot open wrong NPC. Every original four function plus all eight reservations reachable with baseline legal jumps, no granted future abilities.

findings.static_observation: Wall contacts, rejected receivers, and accepted HP changes are distinct; terrain occlusion must keep precedence when adding VFX.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Blocked/denied hits may show material impact but never accepted-health blood/sound/energy grant; all hostile projectile subclasses covered, pause/epoch disposal produces no fake explosion.

findings.static_observation: Connected region is generated_plains branch using global assembler bounds.grow(100); fixed y690 is not its consumer. Exact reported false fall source requires runtime geometry and source_id.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Legitimate lower floor/one-way/carrier/diagonal landing and leave-upper-room are safe; actual unsupported abyss still returns once. Record policy request source and world support, not camera viewport.

findings.static_observation: Adding decoration must respect dynamic platforms, hazard edges, gate shot lines, reward markers and legal landing space.
findings.minimal_counterexample: Same-seed before/after collision/resource/AI/RNG equality, actual camera samples both maps, no root-floating or foreground occlusion of body/projectile/sole landing.

required_outputs: global and all local damage source attribution
new glyph readable at actual camera
gate art and boss seal collision/readability
